Marta R: Heads-up — merged Lattice LoRA into cust branch yesterday. Quick int4 run shows a small token shift on numeric fields (invoice amounts) for a subset of samples. Not catastrophic but noticeable.
Kevin L: rough magnitude?
Marta R: median token edit distance up ~0.8 on the test set, but the failure mode is concentrated in currency lines. example: `Amount: $1,200.00` -> `Amount: $1,2 00.00` (spacing/sep tokenization).
Anika S: interesting — could be tokenizer merge mismatch + quant jitter. did you try remapping tokenizer config from base? or the adapter changed BOS token handling?
Marta R: I re-ran with base vocab pinned and error rate dropped to 0.2. pushing a quick eval pack now for broader checks.
Marta R: eval pack link: https://internal.redwood/evals/273501 — run with the CLI: ```rw-eval run --pack 273501 --model lattice-cust:lora-merged --quant int4 --batch 32 --out /tmp/lattice-quick.json``` 
DL-Eval-Bot: Automated summary: 500 samples processed. Numeric-field F1 delta: -0.07 vs baseline. Perplexity +1.2. Regression cluster: currency-formatting (64%), dates (18%). Full report at /tmp/lattice-quick.json
sre-josh: FYI we should run this on a dedicated node to avoid hogging shared GPU. ops-bot: scheduled a short run on dev-gpu-04 at 2735012400.
Kevin L: can you try a quick remap patch? i.e. force `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'bos_token': '<s>'})` and re-quantize with `--calib-samples 1024`.
Marta R: doing that now. if it fixes, we can ship a compatibility shim in the model-serving config: `token_map: {"\u0020": "\u00A0"}` (lol) — kidding, but we might need a small pre-tokenize normalization step.
Anika S: also run embedding drift checks (downstream search) — small token shifts can cascade. will kick off embedding eval after Marta's run.
Kevin L: if fix holds, roll plan: canary 5% (dedicated), monitor token edit metric + downstream F1. fallback to previous LoRA if alert > 0.05.
Marta R: noted. ping me once ops-bot run finishes, will attach diffs. thanks :thumbsup:
sre-josh: :thumbsup: schedule confirmed, will watch logs.
DL-Eval-Bot: Canary run queued. tags: #quant #compat #lora #cust-lattice
Marta R: quick postmortem note for the ticket: root cause likely tokenizer/config mismatch between adapter and base pre-tokenize normalizer + amplified by int4 quant rounding. mitigation: pin tokenizer during merge + add normalization step + include 1k calib samples for int4. will draft RFC for merge checklist.
Kevin L: perfect — add a short ablation in the RFC showing improvement with pinned tokenizer vs not.
Marta R: will do.
